boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-San Bernardino
boards.description: Ten purchase-required, under-21-safe San Bernardino food stops with directly published late hours.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 4020 University Pkwy
cards.title: Jack in the Box on University Parkway
cards.subtitle: 4020 University Pkwy, San Bernardino, CA 92407
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru option when you need food after an evening commitment; confirm the posted hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A University Parkway drive-thru with hours extending to 3:30 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours of 4:30 a.m.–3:30 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 4020 University Pkwy
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 4:30 a.m.–3:30 a.m. daily; lobby hours are listed separately through 10 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Ostrems Way
cards.subtitle: 1990 Ostrems Way, San Bernardino, CA 92407
cards.notes: Plan this as a drive-thru stop and check the day’s schedule; the late window is longer on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An Ostrems Way drive-thru listed through 2 a.m., or 4 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page lists drive-thru service until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru listed until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Carl’s Jr. on University Parkway
cards.subtitle: 4424 University Parkway, San Bernardino, CA 92407
cards.notes: Use the University Parkway location for a late food stop; Thursday through Saturday have the latest posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A University Parkway restaurant listed until 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists hours until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours run to midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; this location lists a drive-thru.

cards.title: Papa Johns on University Parkway
cards.subtitle: 4434 University Pkwy, Suite C, San Bernardino, CA 92407
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery before the posted cutoff, especially if your evening plans fall on Friday or Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A University Parkway pizza option with carryout until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists carryout and delivery until midnight on Friday and Saturday, and 11 p.m. other days.
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery are listed until midnight Friday–Saturday and 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Kendall Drive
cards.subtitle: 1050 Kendall Dr, Suite D, San Bernardino, CA 92407
cards.notes: Choose carryout or delivery from the Kendall Drive shop; allow time for ordering rather than arriving at the closing minute.
cards.short_summary: A 92407 Pizza Hut listed through midnight daily and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists restaurant hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant hours run to midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday for delivery and carryout.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on East Highland Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1102 E Highland Ave, San Bernardino, CA 92404
cards.notes: For a consistently late pizza option, order delivery or carryout at this East Highland Avenue location before 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: An East Highland Avenue Pizza Hut with 1 a.m. posted hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists delivery and carryout hours of 10 a.m.–1 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout are listed 10 a.m.–1 a.m. daily.

cards.title: In-N-Out at Harriman Place
cards.subtitle: 1065 Harriman Pl, San Bernardino, CA 92408
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or dine-in seating if heading southeast from campus; Friday and Saturday are listed later than other nights.
cards.short_summary: A San Bernardino In-N-Out with drive-thru and dining listed until 1 or 1:30 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and dine-in seating are listed; normal hours end 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Hospitality Lane
cards.subtitle: 385 E Hospitality Lane, San Bernardino, CA 92408
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive-thru pickup when traveling near Hospitality Lane; the listing shows very late nightly service.
cards.short_summary: A Hospitality Lane Taco Bell with drive-thru hours extending to 3 or 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 4 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 3 a.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 4 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 3 a.m. Sunday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Highland
cards.subtitle: 295 W Highland, San Bernardino, CA 92405
cards.notes: Use the West Highland drive-thru as a late option and verify the location page on the day, since hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A West Highland Taco Bell identified by its official city listing as open late until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official San Bernardino location listing identifies this 295 W Highland Taco Bell as open until 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in San Bernardino, CA
cards.access_notes: The official city location page currently displays this location as open until 2 a.m.; use drive-thru availability as posted.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 3265 W Little League Dr
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Little League Drive
cards.subtitle: 3265 W Little League Dr, San Bernardino, CA 92407
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the late window; the lobby is listed to close earlier, so plan the format of your stop accordingly.
cards.short_summary: A 92407 Jack in the Box drive-thru listed until 2 a.m., or 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. most nights and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 3265 W Little League Dr
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; lobby is listed until 10 p.m.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented CSUSB rituals and recurring campus practices, from the Coyote hand sign to a finals-week stop at Wild Song.

cards.title: Ask Me! Booths
cards.subtitle: First week of each CSUSB semester
cards.notes: At the start of a semester, stop at an Ask Me! booth for directions, questions, and a quick snack from campus volunteers.
cards.short_summary: A first-week welcome ritual staffed by faculty, staff, and administrators.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB says Ask Me! booths operate during the first week of each semester, with volunteers helping students navigate campus.
cards.access_notes: Look for the booths during the first week of the semester.

cards.title: Close Commencement with the Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: CSUSB commencement ceremonies
cards.notes: Graduating? Stay through the close of the ceremony and join the graduating class in singing “San Bernardino, Our Alma Mater.”
cards.short_summary: CSUSB graduates close commencement by singing the campus alma mater.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB identifies singing “San Bernardino, Our Alma Mater” at the close of commencement as a campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: Participation is tied to commencement; follow ceremony directions.

cards.title: Start as a Coyote at Convocation
cards.subtitle: First-Year Experience and Associated Students, Inc.
cards.notes: First-year Coyotes can attend the annual convocation to meet peers in their college and learn campus-engagement basics.
cards.short_summary: An annual welcome gathering co-hosted for first-year CSUSB students.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB says First-Year Experience and Associated Students, Inc. co-host an annual New Student Convocation for first-year Coyotes.
cards.access_notes: For first-year students; check university event communications for timing.

cards.title: Spend Coyote Cares Day in Service
cards.subtitle: Community service across the Inland Empire
cards.notes: Register through the event organizer when announced, then volunteer alongside the campus community with local nonprofit partners.
cards.short_summary: CSUSB’s annual service day connects the campus with local community agencies.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB describes Coyote Cares Day as an annual volunteer-service day involving students, faculty, staff, alumni, nonprofits, and community agencies.
cards.access_notes: Participation locations and registration vary by year.

cards.title: Mark Year’s End at Coyote Fest
cards.subtitle: Annual end-of-school-year celebration
cards.notes: Watch for the annual event listing, then spend time with carnival games, rides, interactive activities, and live entertainment.
cards.short_summary: A CSUSB year-end celebration built around games, rides, activities, and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB calls Coyote Fest its annual end-of-school-year party with carnival games, rides, interactive activities, and live entertainment.
cards.access_notes: See the current event listing for eligibility and event details.

cards.title: Put Your Coyotes Up
cards.subtitle: Campus spirit gesture • #CoyotesUp
cards.notes: Use the Coyote hand sign in a campus photo or at a CSUSB event, and share it with the #CoyotesUp tag if desired.
cards.short_summary: A daily expression of Coyote pride with an officially uncertain origin.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB says the Coyote hand signal’s origin is unclear but that students use it daily to display Coyote Pride.
cards.access_notes: Its origin is documented by CSUSB as unclear; participation is optional.

cards.title: Follow the Howl to Coyote Hour
cards.subtitle: Scheduled campus involvement hour
cards.notes: Keep the designated hour open and use it to visit an activity, workshop, or campus program instead of scheduling a class then.
cards.short_summary: A protected hour intended for student involvement and campus connection.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB describes Coyote Hour as a daily hour without planned courses so students can participate in university activities.
cards.access_notes: Programming changes; consult current campus calendars for activities.

cards.title: Homecoming Has a Volleyball Game
cards.subtitle: Coyote pride and a women’s volleyball game
cards.notes: Join the scheduled Homecoming activities, then catch the women’s volleyball game that serves as CSUSB’s homecoming game.
cards.short_summary: CSUSB Homecoming centers a women’s volleyball game instead of football.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB states that its Homecoming game is a women’s volleyball game rather than a traditional football game.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current Homecoming schedule and game details before attending.

cards.title: Dress Up for Howl at the Moon
cards.subtitle: Annual SMSU Program Board Halloween dance
cards.notes: When the annual fall event is announced, plan a costume that follows event rules and join the SMSU Program Board dance.
cards.short_summary: A CSUSB Halloween-costume dance traditionally held around October.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB says SMSU’s Program Board hosts the annual Howl at the Moon dance, normally in October, and encourages Halloween costumes.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Program Board event listing and costume guidance.

cards.title: Rub Wild Song’s Paw Before Finals
cards.subtitle: Bronze coyote outside SMSU-South’s west entrance
cards.notes: Before finals, visit the Wild Song sculpture at the SMSU-South west entrance and take part in the documented good-luck paw ritual.
cards.short_summary: A bronze coyote sculpture tied to CSUSB finals-week luck.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSB documented the tradition of rubbing Wild Song’s paw for good luck during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Wild Song is outside the west entrance of Santos Manuel Student Union-South.
